Description: Deals damage equal to the amount of stacks at the end of the turn. After dealing damage the value is reduced by half.
Absorbs damage equal to the amount of stacks. Decays completely at the end of the turn.
Deals damage back to the attacker equal to the amount of stacks. Loses 1 stack per activation.
Any core stat change consumes 1 stack of static and deals 1 damage. Consumed stacks deal 1 damage bypassing armor.
